findings.passage: “As a constitutional amendment, it’s the people of Pennsylvania who are going to decide if voter ID is an important component of our election system,” said Pennycuick. “Voters support this commonsense requirement, IDs are not difficult to obtain, and there is no evidence requiring an ID when voting in person negatively effects turnout.”
findings.note: News release from her office announcing a constitutional amendment to require ID when voting in person; it also says anyone without a valid ID could receive one at no cost.
subjects: free ID for voters without one

findings.passage: Voter ID laws stop multiple types of fraud, such as impersonating another registered voter, preventing noncitizens from voting, and stopping out-of-state residents or someone registered in multiple jurisdictions.
findings.note: Same release; ties voter ID to non-citizen voting and double registration.

findings.passage: To help restore voter confidence and improve election integrity, I’m leading an effort to pass a constitutional amendment in the General Assembly to require identification when voting in person.
findings.note: Issue page on her site (undated). States her aim of a constitutional amendment requiring ID for in-person voting.

findings.passage: The good news is that IDs are not difficult to obtain. In Pennsylvania, voters have 15 ID options approved by the Pennsylvania Department of State. Any individual who does not possess a valid form of ID could receive one at no cost to ensure no voter is prevented from participating in the election process.
findings.note: Issue page (undated). Says there are many accepted IDs and a free ID for anyone without one.
subjects: free ID for voters without one

findings.passage: I’m introducing legislation to strengthen Pennsylvania’s election security by requiring voters to present identification when voting in person.
findings.note: E-newsletter item titled Introducing Voter ID Legislation to Secure PA Elections; says the constitutional amendment will provide 15 approved ID options and a free ID for anyone without one.
subjects: free ID for voters without one
